trap.see: The key lies under a frozen tile: thaw that tile first (its neighbours go, then it), then take both keys together; grabbing the free key first leaves it waiting in the tray through the whole dig.

examples.text: Try 1 of campaign 1: the first losing move (off stored clock route, tile 69) was removal 1 of 76, at a designed trap; the loss (clock) showed 10 removals later.
